name: Vatsal Kanojiya
headline: I build the quiet machinery behind businesses.
intro: Backend engineer shipping production ERP, billing, HR and payment systems on Frappe/ERPNext — and building on Django, DRF, Celery and PostgreSQL. I own delivery end to end: from the client workshop, through data modelling and APIs, to release.
openTo: Open to backend roles — Django, Python, PostgreSQL.

stats.label: report time after killing N+1 queries

process.text: Write acceptance criteria before a line of code. The spec is the contract — for me and for the agent.
Claude Code agents implement against the spec. I steer architecture, data model and edge cases.
Verification scripts run inside rolled-back transactions, so real data is exercised and nothing is left behind.
Every generated diff is read by me. That's how a quantity above the top slab billing at ₹0 got caught before release.
